title: The Household of God
reflectionText: Life in God’s household joins prayer for all people with tested character, faithful service, and conduct shaped by the truth. Which quiet qualification—gentleness, integrity, self-control, hospitality, or faithfulness—most needs patient attention today?
editorialNotes: Packet 012 initial writer output. The story presents the assigned instructions without inventing a church meeting, biographies, reactions, or doctrinal harmonization beyond 1 Timothy 2:1-3:16.
